title: Close Brothers provides £20m for Radlett housing scheme
summary:
Close Brothers Property Finance has provided a £20 million revolving credit facility to housebuilder gs8 for the development of 52 homes in Radlett, Hertfordshire. The scheme carries a gross development value of £47 million and includes a zero energy bills guarantee.

title: Cheshire pub conversion secures £2m bridging finance
summary:
Black & White Bridging has provided a £2 million bridging finance facility for the conversion of a former Cheshire public house into a holiday let property. The transaction involved refinancing existing debt and releasing additional capital to complete the development.

The post Cheshire pub conversion secures £2m bridging finance appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Bank of England expected to hold rates at 3.75% Thursday
summary:
The Bank of England is anticipated to maintain interest rates at 3.75% when the Monetary Policy Committee announces its decision on Thursday, though geopolitical tensions are introducing fresh uncertainty. Most economists predict a 7-2 vote split in favour of holding rates, following June inflation data showing CPI at 2.6%, its lowest level for 15 months.

title: Buyers could save 28% by purchasing in neighbouring postcodes
summary:
Homebuyers in the UK could reduce property costs by up to 47% by purchasing in postcodes adjacent to the country's most expensive areas, according to research from Lloyds Bank. The study found that homes in neighbouring areas cost 28% less on average nationally.

title: Out-of-hours property enquiry data reveals industry gaps
summary:
The property industry lacks independent data on out-of-hours enquiries, with widely cited figures ranging from 26% to 91% based on suppliers' own datasets. Analysis reveals commonly quoted portal statistics are misinterpreted, whilst independent research shows peak enquiry activity occurs at 8:48pm, creating a mismatch with agent availability.

title: Gazeal attracts 200 agents to upfront survey service
summary:
Property transaction platform Gazeal has secured sign-ups from over 200 estate agents for its upfront seller survey service, which provides buyers with accredited surveyor reports before offers are made. The service operates through a network of more than 1,000 surveyors covering nearly all UK postcodes.

title: Landlords raise asking rents following new legislation
summary:
More than a third of landlords have increased their asking rents in the months following the introduction of the Renters' Rights Act, according to research from estate agent Chestertons. The firm's latest quarterly report found a 36% annual increase in landlords raising their initial marketing prices.

title: Rayner maintains 1.5 million homes target despite challenges
summary:
Angela Rayner has reaffirmed her commitment to delivering 1.5 million new homes, acknowledging the difficulty of the target in a Radio 4 interview. The Housing Secretary confirmed the government is not considering rent controls in England.

title: Landlord consolidates 54-unit portfolio under single lender
summary:
A property investor has refinanced a 54-unit portfolio spanning residential, commercial and semi-commercial assets, consolidating borrowing from five separate lenders into one arrangement. The transaction was structured across three facilities to accommodate different asset types and ownership structures.

The post Landlord consolidates 54-unit portfolio under single lender appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Atom bank funds £2.35m loan for Mayfair hotel reopening
summary:
Atom bank has provided a £2.35 million commercial mortgage to finance the reopening of a hotel in Mayfair, London, which had been closed for more than five years following the Covid-19 pandemic. The deal was arranged after approximately nine lenders rejected the application due to concerns about the hotel sector and the borrowers' limited industry experience.
